messages.subject: Compile errors associated with TMB.hpp
parts:
Once I updated to R4.0.3 from 3.6  and updated Rtools for 4.0 I started receiving a slew of warning messages that are associated with the INCLUDE TMB.hpp line of any cpp.  Below is a partial error list using the linreg.cpp example - line 2 is the include statement.  The odd thing is that the .dll is built and everything works just fine.

I'm using Windows with R64 version 4.0.3 and all of my packages are up to date. I've exhausted my ideas of what could be wrong. Any idea what is going on and how I can correct it?  Right now it is just a mere nuisance but...

regards --jeff
